thread:
maya: Quick sync — private deploy roadmap for customer-managed networking. Need prioritized launch criteria, a trimmed installer preset list, and an upgrade/rollback SLA for customers who keep their own BGP. Goal: alpha to 2 pilots in Q2.
parth: Prioritization proposal: 1) egress stability (static IP preservation), 2) BGP handoff runbook, 3) deterministic rollback. Everything else P2.
samir: Suggest an "operational manifest" artifact: one-page runbook + machine-readable manifest for field teams to reduce back-and-forth.
maya: Keep manifest minimal: required network inputs, firewall/ACL expectations, test endpoints, and post-install smoke tests.
lee: Security: artifact signature verification, KMS import steps, cert rotation, and outbound allowlist for telemetry. Mark compliance checks in manifest.
parth: Installer presets: `vpc-basic`, `keep-your-egress`, `airgap-strict`. Map each to a concise required-customer-actions list.
samir: Manifest snippet to attach to installs (for field):
```json
{
  "preset": "keep-your-egress",
  "customer_steps": ["announce-prefix", "open-icmp-for-probes", "provide-bgp-neighbor"],
  "test_endpoints": ["10.0.0.5:443","10.0.0.6:80"]
}
```
maya: Upgrade policy: operator upgrades must support a "fast revert" that restores previous operator image and re-applies iptables/routing within 20 minutes. Field should trigger via operator CLI.
lee: Preload KV/cache snapshot during canary to avoid cold-start regressions; include an egress-stability smoke test that checks source IP before/after.
deploy-bot: CI alert: private-onramp/e2e bgp-handoff.test flaky (2/10 failures). Logs: https://ci.internal/4567 :warning: 
parth: Assigning @samir and @lee to triage CI; likely routing mismatch with vendor.
samir: Will run debug harness + packet captures, ETA EOD.
maya: Launch gate suggestion: GO if 1) static-egress validated in two distinct customers, 2) rollback validated once end-to-end, 3) manifest + runbook delivered and security signs off on offline artifact signatures. NO-GO if any gate fails.
lee: Also require dashboards for per-tenant latency and egress-change alerts before GA.
maya: Action items: samir (CI/BGP triage), parth (draft manifest template + installer preset docs), lee (security gating + KMS tests), maya (ship runbook draft). Reconvene Fri 10:30. :rocket:
deploy-bot: Reminder: nightly network sweep tomorrow 04:00 UTC.
maya: Thanks — post updates in the drive doc and ping this thread.
